opportunities.name: Axe-catch spellblade rhythm
opportunities.objective: Make each catch a controlled ability-and-attack sequence.
opportunities.mechanic: Spinning Axe adds up to 1.15 AD statFormula=2 physical damage to its attack; catching refreshes Blood Rush. Essence Reaver adds physical Spellblade and mana to a post-W attack, while Stormrazor's energized speed helps reach the next landing circle. Crit supports ordinary attack damage but axe bonus treatment must be measured separately.
opportunities.requiredState: Need two maintained axes, sensible W pacing and room to catch safely.
opportunities.failure: Rapid W refreshes can outpace Spellblade readiness and catching into CC loses both axes.
opportunities.test: Compare mana and total trade damage with W only when Spellblade is ready versus spammed catches.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Catch refresh does not refresh Essence Reaver's internal item cooldown.

opportunities.name: Whirling execution specialist
opportunities.objective: Prioritize two-pass ultimate damage and earned Adoration thresholds.
opportunities.mechanic: Whirling Death has a rank-varying 1.1-1.5 AD expression, reverses after champion contact or recast and loses damage through earlier units. Muramana supplies AD/mana subject to spell proc limits; Axiom refunds R only after qualifying deaths, and lethality serves physical damage. Passive Adoration provides a bounded execute threshold, not combat stats or guaranteed income.
opportunities.requiredState: Need charged Manamune, earned surviving Adoration and an unobstructed return line.
opportunities.failure: Dying halves stacks; unit attenuation or target movement can erase the execute setup.
opportunities.test: Measure both R passes at fixed stack counts and compare early reversal versus maximum travel.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Adoration stacks are not unlimited and catching axes does not directly lower R cooldown.

ruledOut.reason: Q's added physical term does not explicitly inherit the attack's crit multiplier.

unknowns: Verify crit treatment of Q bonus and Muramana eligibility on the outbound/return passes.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Rapid W refreshes can outpace Spellblade readiness and catching into CC loses both axes.

tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Catch refresh does not refresh Essence Reaver's internal item cooldown.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Essence Reaver, Bloodthirster, Stormrazor, Infinity Edge, Lord Dominik's Regards, Berserker's Greaves. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.
